```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
```
```
    }
}
```

```
public class IsRectangleOverlap {
    public static boolean isRectangleOverlap(int[] rec1, int[] rec2) {
        int left1   = rec1[0];
        int bottom1 = rec1[1];
        int right1  = rec1[2];
        int top1    = rec1[3];

        int left2   = rec2[0];
        int bottom2 = rec2[1];
        int right2  = rec2[2];
        int top2    = rec2[3];

        return !(bottom2 >= top1 ||
                 top2 <= bottom1 ||
                 left2 >= right1 ||
                 right2 <= left1);
```
```
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```

```
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() <= txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == (\forall int i; 0 <= i < pat.length(); pat.charAt(i) == txt.charAt(i));
    //@ also
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() > txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
```
```
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsIdentity {
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
```
```
                } else {
```

```
                }
            }
```
```
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {

            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
```
```
    }
}
```

```
        /*@ 
          @ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n;
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    /*@ 
      @ // Case: null or empty array -> true
      @ requires digits == null || digits.length == 0;
      @ assigns \nothing;
      @ ensures \result == true;
      @ also
      @ // Case: non-null, non-empty array -> precise characterization
      @ requires digits != null && digits.length > 0;
      @ assigns \nothing;
      @ ensures \result == (
      @     // all symmetric pairs satisfy the strobogrammatic relation
      @     (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < digits.length/2;
      @         ((digits[i] == 0 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 0) ||
      @          (digits[i] == 1 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 1) ||
      @          (digits[i] == 8 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 8) ||
      @          (digits[i] == 6 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 9) ||
      @          (digits[i] == 9 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 6))
      @     )
      @     &&
      @     // if odd length, the middle digit must be 0,1, or 8
```
```
      @     ( (digits.length % 2 == 0) ||
      @       (digits[digits.length/2] == 0 || digits[digits.length/2] == 1 || digits[digits.length/2] == 8) )
      @ );
      @ behaviors disjoint;
      @ behaviors complete;
      @*/
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= len/2;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i;
        //@                ((digits[j] == 0 && digits[len - j - 1] == 0) ||
        //@                 (digits[j] == 1 && digits[len - j - 1] == 1) ||
        //@                 (digits[j] == 8 && digits[len - j - 1] == 8) ||
        //@                 (digits[j] == 6 && digits[len - j - 1] == 9) ||
        //@                 (digits[j] == 9 && digits[len - j - 1] == 6)));
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases (len/2) - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
```
```
                return false;
            }
        }
```

```
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```

```
     @                (\forall int k; p < k && k < q ==> arr[p] != arr[k])
     @            );

    public static boolean allUnique(int[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return true;

        /* Outer loop invariant:
           - 0 <= i <= arr.length
           - for every processed index p < i, arr[p] is distinct from every element at any index q > p
         */
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= arr.length;
        //@ maintaining \forall int p; 0 <= p < i; \forall int q; p < q < arr.length; arr[p] != arr[q];
```

```
               - outer invariant preserved
               - for the current i, all indices q with i < q < j satisfy arr[i] != arr[q]
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {

                return null;
            }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
```
```
    }
}
```

```
        int right1  = rec1[2];
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
```
```
            } else {

            }
        }

        return ret;
```
```
    }
```

```
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() <= txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == (\forall int i; 0 <= i < pat.length(); pat.charAt(i) == txt.charAt(i));
    //@ also
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() > txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
```

```
public class ScalarProductSaturated {
    public static int[] scalarProductSaturated(int[] vec, int a) {
        if (vec == null) return null;
        int ret[] = new int[vec.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < vec.length; i++) {
            long prod = (long) vec[i] * (long) a;
            if (prod > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            } else if (prod < Integer.MIN_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
            } else {
                ret[i] = (int) prod;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
      @             ==> \result[i] == (int)((long)vec[i] * (long)a))
      @        );
      @*/
    public static int[] scalarProductSaturated(int[] vec, int a) {
        if (vec == null) return null;
        int ret[] = new int[vec.length];
        /*@ 
          @ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= vec.length;
          @ maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i;
          @                 ((long)vec[j] * (long)a > Integer.MAX_VALUE  ==> ret[j] == Integer.MAX_VALUE)
          @              && ((long)vec[j] * (long)a < Integer.MIN_VALUE ==> ret[j] == Integer.MIN_VALUE)
          @              && (Integer.MIN_VALUE <= (long)vec[j] * (long)a && (long)vec[j] * (long)a <= Integer.MAX_VALUE
          @                  ==> ret[j] == (int)((long)vec[j] * (long)a))
          @             );
          @ loop_writes ret[*], i;
          @ decreases vec.length - i;
          @*/
        for (int i = 0; i < vec.length; i++) {
            long prod = (long) vec[i] * (long) a;
            if (prod > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            } else if (prod < Integer.MIN_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
            } else {
                ret[i] = (int) prod;
            }
        }
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

Please generate JML specifications for the Java program given below.

```
public class IsIdentity {
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}

```

```
      @ // Case 4: a is well-formed n x n but differs from identity in at least one entry -> returns false
      @ also
```

```
      @          && (\forall int i; 0 <= i < a.length; a[i] != null && a[i].length == a.length)

      @                  (i == j ? a[i][j] != 1 : a[i][j] != 0));
      @ assigns \nothing;
      @ ensures \result == false;
      @*/
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        /*@
          @ // Outer loop invariant: 0 <= i <= n and all rows < i are well-formed and already checked to match identity
          @ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n;
          @ maintaining (\forall int p; 0 <= p < i;
          @                  a[p] != null && a[p].length == n &&
          @                  (\forall int q; 0 <= q < n; (p == q ? a[p][q] == 1 : a[p][q] == 0)));
          @ loop_writes i;
          @ decreases n - i;
          @*/
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            /*@
              @ // Inner loop invariant: 0 <= j <= n and entries in row i at columns < j match identity condition
              @ maintaining 0 <= j && j <= n;
              @ maintaining (\forall int q; 0 <= q < j; (i == q ? a[i][q] == 1 : a[i][q] == 0));
              @ maintaining a[i] != null && a[i].length == n;
              @ loop_writes j;
              @ decreases n - j;
              @*/
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
```

```
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {

```
```
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] != mat[i - 1][j - 1]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class Mul {
```
```
    public static long mul(int x, int y) {
        int m = x, n = y, sign = 1;
        if (x < 0) {
            m = -x;
            sign = -sign;
        }
```

```
public class Mul {
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  pure
    //@  // Case: both absolute values are positive => the nested loops execute and compute m*n
    //@  requires ( (x < 0 ? -x : x) > 0 ) && ( (y < 0 ? -y : y) > 0 );
    //@  ensures \result == ((x < 0 ? -1L : 1L) * (y < 0 ? -1L : 1L))
    //@                  * ((long)(x < 0 ? -x : x) * (long)(y < 0 ? -y : y));
    //@ also
    //@  // Case: at least one of the computed bounds is non-positive => loops do not contribute => result 0
    //@  requires ! ( ( (x < 0 ? -x : x) > 0 ) && ( (y < 0 ? -y : y) > 0 ) );
    //@  ensures \result == 0L;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    //@ behaviors complete;
    public static long mul(int x, int y) {
        int m = x, n = y, sign = 1;
        if (x < 0) {
            m = -x;
            sign = -sign;
        }
        if (y < 0) {
            n = -y;
            sign = -sign;
        }

        long res = 0;

        /*@ 
            // Outer loop invariant: i is non-negative and does not exceed m when m >= 0;
            // res equals i * n when n>0, otherwise res == 0.
            maintaining 0 <= i && (m < 0 || i <= m);
            maintaining res == ( (n > 0) ? (long)i * (long)n : 0L );
            loop_writes i, res;
            decreases m - i;
        @*/
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            /*@
                // Inner loop invariant: j is non-negative and does not exceed n when n >= 0;
                // during the inner loop res equals (completed outer iterations contribution) + j
                maintaining 0 <= j && (n < 0 || j <= n);
                maintaining res == ( (long)i * ( (n > 0) ? (long)n : 0L ) ) + (long)j;
                loop_writes j, res;
                decreases n - j;
            @*/
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                res = res + 1;
            }
        }
        return sign * res;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsReverseArray {
    public static boolean isReverseArray(int[] x, int[] y) {
        if (x.length != y.length)
            return false;
        int index = 0;

        while (index < x.length) {
            if (x[index] != y[x.length - 1 - index]) {
                return false;
            } else {
                index = index + 1;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class ScalarProductSaturated {
    public static int[] scalarProductSaturated(int[] vec, int a) {
        if (vec == null) return null;
        int ret[] = new int[vec.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < vec.length; i++) {
            long prod = (long) vec[i] * (long) a;
            if (prod > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            } else if (prod < Integer.MIN_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
            } else {
                ret[i] = (int) prod;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
```

```
      @            \result[i][j] == a[i][j] + b[i][j]);
      @*/
    public static int[][] matrixSum(int[][] a, int[][] b) {
        int n = a.length;
        int m = a[0].length;

        int[][] c = new int[n][m];

        /*@ 
          @ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n;
```
```
          @ maintaining c.length == n;
          @ maintaining (\forall int ii; 0 <= ii && ii < n; c[ii] != null && c[ii].length == m);

          @ decreases n - i;
```

```
              @ maintaining 0 <= i && i < n;
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
```

```
public class IsPowerOfTwo {
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        }

        return true;
    }
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

    }
```

```
      @  requires (y > 0)  ==> x <= Integer.MAX_VALUE - y;
      @  requires (y < 0)  ==> x >= Integer.MIN_VALUE - y;
      @  assigns \nothing;
      @  ensures \result == x + y;
      @*/
    public static int add(int x, int y) {
        int sum = x;
        if (y > 0) {
            int n = y;
            /*@ 
              @   maintaining 0 <= n && n <= y;
              @   maintaining sum == x + (y - n);
              @   loop_writes sum, n;
              @   decreases n;
              @*/
            while (n > 0) {
                sum = sum + 1;
                n = n - 1;
            }
        } else {
            int n = -y;
            /*@ 
              @   maintaining 0 <= n && n <= -y;
              @   maintaining sum == x + y + n;
              @   loop_writes sum, n;
              @   decreases n;
              @*/
            while (n > 0) {
                sum = sum - 1;
                n = n - 1;
            }
        }
        return sum;
    }
}
```

```
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
```

```
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {

            return false;
```

```
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \fresh(\result);
```
```
    //@ ensures \result.length == original.length;
    //@ ensures \forall int i; 0 <= i < \result.length; \result[i] == original[\result.length - 1 - i];
    public static int[] reverse(int[] original) {
        int n = original.length;
        int[] res = new int[n];

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; res[j] == original[n - 1 - j];
        //@ loop_writes res[*];
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            res[i] = original[n - i - 1];
        }
        return res;
    }
}
```

```
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsIdentity {
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
      @     (\forall int i; 0 <= i < a.length;
      @         a[i] != null && a[i].length == a.length &&
      @         (\forall int j; 0 <= j < a.length;
      @             (i == j ? a[i][j] == 1 : a[i][j] == 0)
      @         )
      @     )
      @ );
      @ assigns \nothing;
      @*/
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        /*@ 
          @ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n;
          @ maintaining (\forall int r; 0 <= r < i;
          @                a[r] != null && a[r].length == n &&
          @                (\forall int c; 0 <= c < n; (r == c ? a[r][c] == 1 : a[r][c] == 0))
          @ );
          @ loop_writes i;
          @ decreases n - i;
          @*/
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            /*@ 
              @ maintaining 0 <= j && j <= n;
              @ maintaining a[i] != null && a[i].length == n;
              @ maintaining (\forall int c; 0 <= c < j; (i == c ? a[i][c] == 1 : a[i][c] == 0));
              @ loop_writes j;
              @ decreases n - j;
              @*/
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
```

```
public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] != mat[i - 1][j - 1]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    //@  requires digits == null || digits.length == 0;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == true;
    //@ also
    //@  requires digits != null && digits.length > 0;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == (
    //@      (\forall int i; 0 <= i < digits.length/2;
    //@          ((digits[i] == 0 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 0) ||
    //@           (digits[i] == 1 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 1) ||
    //@           (digits[i] == 8 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 8) ||
    //@           (digits[i] == 6 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 9) ||
    //@           (digits[i] == 9 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 6))
    //@      )
    //@      && (digits.length % 2 == 1
    //@          ==> (digits[digits.length / 2] == 0 ||
    //@               digits[digits.length / 2] == 1 ||
    //@               digits[digits.length / 2] == 8))
    //@  );
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    //@ behaviors complete;
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= len/2;
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i;
        //@           ((digits[j] == 0 && digits[len - j - 1] == 0) ||
        //@            (digits[j] == 1 && digits[len - j - 1] == 1) ||
        //@            (digits[j] == 8 && digits[len - j - 1] == 8) ||
        //@            (digits[j] == 6 && digits[len - j - 1] == 9) ||
        //@            (digits[j] == 9 && digits[len - j - 1] == 6));
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases (len/2) - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
    //@               )
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
            return false;

        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```

```
public class ScalarProductSaturated {
    public static int[] scalarProductSaturated(int[] vec, int a) {
        if (vec == null) return null;
        int ret[] = new int[vec.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < vec.length; i++) {
            long prod = (long) vec[i] * (long) a;
            if (prod > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            } else if (prod < Integer.MIN_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
            } else {
                ret[i] = (int) prod;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
    //@  assigns \nothing;
```
```
    //@  ensures \result == (\forall int i; 0 <= i < pat.length(); pat.charAt(i) == txt.charAt(i));

    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() > txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsIdentity {
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {

            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class Mul {
    public static long mul(int x, int y) {
        int m = x, n = y, sign = 1;
        if (x < 0) {
            m = -x;
            sign = -sign;
        }
```

```
    public static long mul(int x, int y) {
```

```
public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] != mat[i - 1][j - 1]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() <= txt.length();

    //@ also
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() > txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class ScalarProductSaturated {
    public static int[] scalarProductSaturated(int[] vec, int a) {
        if (vec == null) return null;
        int ret[] = new int[vec.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < vec.length; i++) {
            long prod = (long) vec[i] * (long) a;
            if (prod > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            } else if (prod < Integer.MIN_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
            } else {
                ret[i] = (int) prod;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```

```
public class IsUndirectedGraph {
    public static boolean isUndirectedGraph(int[][] adjacencyMat) {
        int nVert = adjacencyMat.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < nVert; i++) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < nVert; j++) {
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IdxFirstElemWithDuplicate {
```
```
    //@ requires arr == null || arr.length == 0;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == -1;
    //@ also
    //@ requires arr != null && arr.length > 0 && (\exists int p, q; 0 <= p && p < q && q < arr.length; arr[p] == arr[q]);
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures 0 <= \result && \result < arr.length;
    //@ ensures (\exists int j; \result < j && j < arr.length && arr[\result] == arr[j]);
    //@ ensures (\forall int k; 0 <= k && k < \result; (\forall int j; k < j && j < arr.length; arr[k] != arr[j]));
    //@ also
    //@ requires arr != null && arr.length > 0 && (\forall int p, q; 0 <= p && p < q && q < arr.length; arr[p] != arr[q]);
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == -1;
    //@ disjoint behaviors;
    //@ complete behaviors;
    public static int idxFirstElemWithDuplicate(int[] arr) {
        if (arr == null || arr.length == 0) return -1;

        /* Outer loop invariant:
           - i is within [0, arr.length-1]
           - for every index k < i there is no later index j > k with arr[k] == arr[j]
        */

        //@ maintaining (\forall int k; 0 <= k && k < i; (\forall int j; k < j && j < arr.length; arr[k] != arr[j]));

               - j is within [i+1, arr.length]
               - for every index j0 in [i+1, j) arr[i] != arr[j0]
               - preserves the outer invariant for k < i

            //@ maintaining (\forall int j0; i+1 <= j0 && j0 < j; arr[i] != arr[j0]);

            //@ loop_writes j;
            //@ decreases arr.length - j;
            for (int j = i + 1; j < arr.length; j++) {

```
```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsReverseArray {
    public static boolean isReverseArray(int[] x, int[] y) {
        if (x.length != y.length)
            return false;
        int index = 0;

        while (index < x.length) {
            if (x[index] != y[x.length - 1 - index]) {
                return false;
            } else {
                index = index + 1;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class TwoSum {
    public static int[] twoSum(int[] nums, int target) {
        int n = nums.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {
                if (nums[i] + nums[j] == target) {
                    return new int[] {i, j};
                }
            }
        }
        return new int[0];
    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    /* Case: null input -> true */
    //@ requires digits == null;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == true;
    //@ also
    /* Case: empty array -> true */
    //@ requires digits != null && digits.length == 0;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == true;
    //@ also
    /* Case: non-empty array -> result iff all mirrored pairs are strobogrammatic
       and (if odd length) the middle digit is one of {0,1,8} */
    //@ requires digits != null && digits.length > 0;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == (
    //@   (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < digits.length/2;
    //@        ((digits[i] == 0 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 0) ||
    //@         (digits[i] == 1 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 1) ||
    //@         (digits[i] == 8 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 8) ||
    //@         (digits[i] == 6 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 9) ||
    //@         (digits[i] == 9 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 6))
    //@   )
    //@   &&
    //@   (digits.length % 2 == 0 ||
    //@     (digits[digits.length/2] == 0 || digits[digits.length/2] == 1 || digits[digits.length/2] == 8))
    //@ );
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    //@ behaviors complete;
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        /* loop invariants: 0 <= i <= len/2 and all processed pairs (j < i) satisfy the strobogrammatic relation */
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= len/2;
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i;
        //@     ((digits[j] == 0 && digits[len - j - 1] == 0) ||
        //@      (digits[j] == 1 && digits[len - j - 1] == 1) ||
        //@      (digits[j] == 8 && digits[len - j - 1] == 8) ||
        //@      (digits[j] == 6 && digits[len - j - 1] == 9) ||
        //@      (digits[j] == 9 && digits[len - j - 1] == 6));
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases len/2 - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
```

```
public class DivArrayByTwo {
    public static void DivArrayByTwo(int[] arr) {

        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length; ++i) {

```
```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

```

```
public class MatrixSum {
    public static int[][] matrixSum(int[][] a, int[][] b) {
        int n = a.length;
        int m = a[0].length;

        int[][] c = new int[n][m];

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                c[i][j] = a[i][j] + b[i][j];
            }
        }

        return c;
    }
}
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
      @   // otherwise toLowerCase(arr[i]) is used.

      @                (Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) ? \result[i] == arr[i]
      @                 : ((i == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[i-1]))

      @                    : \result[i] == Character.toLowerCase(arr[i]))));
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
```

```
public class ArrayConcat {
```

```
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```

```
public class IsIdentity {
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
      @ // Case: null or empty array -> false
      @ requires a == null || a.length == 0;
      @ assigns \nothing;
      @ ensures \result == false;
      @ also
      @ // Case: some row is null or has wrong length -> false
      @ requires a != null && a.length > 0 && (\exists int i; 0 <= i < a.length; a[i] == null || a[i].length != a.length);
      @ assigns \nothing;
      @ ensures \result == false;
      @ also
      @ // Case: all rows non-null and square -> check identity property
      @ requires a != null && a.length > 0 && (\forall int i; 0 <= i < a.length; a[i] != null && a[i].length == a.length);
      @ assigns \nothing;
      @ ensures \result == (\forall int i; 0 <= i < a.length; \forall int j; 0 <= j < a.length; (i == j ? a[i][j] == 1 : a[i][j] == 0));
      @ behaviors disjoint;
      @ behaviors complete;
      @*/
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n;
        //@ maintaining \forall int r; 0 <= r < i; a[r] != null && a[r].length == n && (\forall int c; 0 <= c < n; (r == c ? a[r][c] == 1 : a[r][c] == 0));
```

```
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
```
```
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {

            return false;
```

```
public class Mul {
    public static long mul(int x, int y) {
        int m = x, n = y, sign = 1;
        if (x < 0) {
            m = -x;
            sign = -sign;
        }
        if (y < 0) {
            n = -y;
            sign = -sign;

        long res = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
```

```
    /*@
      @ // Two mutually exclusive behaviours cover all integer inputs.
      @ // Normal case: neither operand is Integer.MIN_VALUE (negation safe).
      @ also
      @   requires x != Integer.MIN_VALUE && y != Integer.MIN_VALUE;
      @   assigns \nothing;
      @   ensures \result == (long) x * (long) y;
      @ // Special case: if either operand is Integer.MIN_VALUE the algorithm
      @ // leaves m or n negative so the nested loops do not perform any increments,
      @ // hence the method returns 0.
      @ also
      @   requires x == Integer.MIN_VALUE || y == Integer.MIN_VALUE;
      @   assigns \nothing;
      @   ensures \result == 0L;
      @ behaviors disjoint;
      @ behaviors complete;
      @*/
    public static long mul(int x, int y) {
        int m = x, n = y, sign = 1;
        if (x < 0) {
            m = -x;
            sign = -sign;
        }
        if (y < 0) {
            n = -y;
            sign = -sign;
        }

        long res = 0;

          @   // Outer loop invariants:
          @   //  - i stays between 0 and max(m,0)
          @   //  - res equals i * max(n,0) (because each completed outer
          @   //    iteration increases res by max(n,0))
          @   maintaining 0 <= i && i <= (m >= 0 ? m : 0);
          @   maintaining res == (long) i * (n >= 0 ? n : 0);

              @   //  - during the inner loop res == (long)i*max(n,0) + j
              @   maintaining 0 <= j && j <= (n >= 0 ? n : 0);
              @   maintaining res == (long) i * (n >= 0 ? n : 0) + j;
              @   loop_writes res, j;
              @   decreases (n >= 0 ? n - j : 0);
```

```
public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    /*@ 
      @ requires mat != null;
      @ requires (\forall int r; 0 <= r && r < mat.length; mat[r] != null);
      @ requires (\forall int r; 0 <= r && r < mat.length; mat[r].length == mat[0].length);
      @ assigns \nothing;
      @ ensures \result == (
      @     mat.length == 0
      @     || (\forall int i; 1 <= i && i < mat.length;
      @            \forall int j; 1 <= j && j < mat[0].length;
      @                mat[i][j] == mat[i-1][j-1])
      @ );
      @*/
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        /*@
          @ // i is always at least 1 (initialized to 1); this guarantees i-1 is non-negative.
          @ maintaining 1 <= i;
          @ // the Toeplitz property has been established for all rows < i (and all valid columns).
          @ maintaining (n >= 1 && m >= 1) ==>
          @     (\forall int p; 1 <= p && p < i;
          @         \forall int q; 1 <= q && q < m;
          @             mat[p][q] == mat[p-1][q-1]);
          @ loop_writes i;
          @ decreases n - i;
          @*/
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            /*@
              @ // j is always at least 1 (initialized to 1); this guarantees j-1 is non-negative.
              @ maintaining 1 <= j;
              @ // the Toeplitz property has been established for all columns < j in the current row i.
              @ maintaining (m >= 1) ==>
              @     (\forall int q; 1 <= q && q < j;
              @         mat[i][q] == mat[i-1][q-1]);
              @ loop_writes j;
              @ decreases m - j;
              @*/
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] != mat[i - 1][j - 1]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class ScalarProductSaturated {
    public static int[] scalarProductSaturated(int[] vec, int a) {
        if (vec == null) return null;
        int ret[] = new int[vec.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < vec.length; i++) {
            long prod = (long) vec[i] * (long) a;
            if (prod > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            } else if (prod < Integer.MIN_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
            } else {
                ret[i] = (int) prod;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
```
```
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {

            }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {

            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||

                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

```
```
public class IsRectangleOverlap {
    public static boolean isRectangleOverlap(int[] rec1, int[] rec2) {
        int left1   = rec1[0];
        int bottom1 = rec1[1];
        int right1  = rec1[2];
        int top1    = rec1[3];

        int left2   = rec2[0];
        int bottom2 = rec2[1];
        int right2  = rec2[2];
        int top2    = rec2[3];

        return !(bottom2 >= top1 ||
                 top2 <= bottom1 ||
                 left2 >= right1 ||
                 right2 <= left1);
    }
}
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
    //@   assigns \nothing;

    //@                         ==> \result[i] == Character.toTitleCase(arr[i]))
    //@                     &&
    //@                     (!(i == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[i-1]))
    //@                         ==> \result[i] == Character.toLowerCase(arr[i]))));
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    //@ behaviors complete;
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {

            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
```

```
public class IsIdentity {
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

            ret[i] = a[i];

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {

        }

        return ret;
    }
```

```
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

```
```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))

    }
}
```

```
public class IsPowerOfTwo {
    public static boolean isPowerOfTwo(int n) {
        if (n <= 0) return false;

        while (n > 1) {
            if (n % 2 != 0) return false;
            n /= 2;
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class MatrixSum {
    public static int[][] matrixSum(int[][] a, int[][] b) {
        int n = a.length;
        int m = a[0].length;

        int[][] c = new int[n][m];

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
```

```
public class DivArrayByTwo {
    public static void DivArrayByTwo(int[] arr) {
        if (arr == null)
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class MatrixSum {
    public static int[][] matrixSum(int[][] a, int[][] b) {
        int n = a.length;
        int m = a[0].length;

        int[][] c = new int[n][m];

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
```

```
      @ assigns \nothing;
      @

      @*/
    public static int[][] matrixSum(int[][] a, int[][] b) {
        int n = a.length;
        int m = a[0].length;

        int[][] c = new int[n][m];
```

```
        //@ assert c.length == n;
        //@ assert (\forall int ii; 0 <= ii && ii < n; c[ii] != null);
        //@ assert (\forall int ii; 0 <= ii && ii < n; c[ii].length == m);

          @ // Outer loop invariant: rows 0..i-1 have been fully processed

          @                 (\forall int jj; 0 <= jj < m;

          @ decreases n - i;
          @*/

              @ maintaining 0 <= j && j <= m;
              @ maintaining (\forall int jj; 0 <= jj < j; c[i][jj] == a[i][jj] + b[i][jj]);
              @ decreases m - j;
              @*/
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
```

assistant: You're right: the verifier complains because it cannot infer, at the point of the array accesses c[i][j], a[i][j] and b[i][j], that the indices i and j are strictly inside the corresponding array lengths. The usual fix is to strengthen the loop invariants so the prover can instantiate the necessary facts (c.length == n, c[i] non-null and c[i].length == m, a[i]/b[i] non-null and length == m, and the bounds relation between j and those lengths).

Below is a corrected set of JML annotations. Changes made (summarized):
- Added outer/inner invariants that explicitly state c.length == n and the relation between c[i].length and m.
- Kept the usual "0 <= j && j <= m" variant invariant but also explicitly maintain the correspondence c[i].length == m and a[i].length == m and b[i].length == m so the prover can conclude j < c[i].length from the loop guard j < m.
- Added the required ensures clauses at the method level (freshness, shape and contents, and inputs unchanged).

Corrected annotated source (only JML comments changed; source code untouched):

```
public class MatrixSum {
    /*@
      @ requires a != null;
      @ requires b != null;
      @ requires a.length > 0; // code uses a[0]
      @ requires (\forall int ii; 0 <= ii < a.length; a[ii] != null && a[ii].length == a[0].length);
      @ requires b.length == a.length;
      @ requires (\forall int ii; 0 <= ii < b.length; b[ii] != null && b[ii].length == a[0].length);
      @ 
      @ // The method does not modify any pre-existing memory reachable from parameters/fields.
      @ assigns \nothing;
      @ 
      @ // Result is a freshly allocated matrix of same dimensions with entrywise sums.
      @ ensures \result != null;
      @ ensures \fresh(\result);
      @ ensures \result.length == a.length;
      @ ensures (\forall int ii, jj;
      @            0 <= ii < a.length && 0 <= jj < a[ii].length
      @            ==> \result[ii][jj] == a[ii][jj] + b[ii][jj]);
      @ 
      @ // inputs are not modified
      @ ensures (\forall int ii, jj;
      @            0 <= ii < a.length && 0 <= jj < a[ii].length
      @            ==> a[ii][jj] == \old(a[ii][jj]) && b[ii][jj] == \old(b[ii][jj]));
      @*/
    public static int[][] matrixSum(int[][] a, int[][] b) {
        int n = a.length;
        int m = a[0].length;

        int[][] c = new int[n][m];

        //@ assert c.length == n;
        //@ assert (\forall int ii; 0 <= ii && ii < n; c[ii] != null);
        //@ assert (\forall int ii; 0 <= ii && ii < n; c[ii].length == m);

        /*@
          @ // Outer loop invariant: rows 0..i-1 have been fully processed
          @ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n;
          @ // c has the same number of rows as n
          @ maintaining c.length == n;
          @ // every row of c is allocated and has length m
          @ maintaining (\forall int ii; 0 <= ii && ii < n; c[ii] != null && c[ii].length == m);
          @ // inputs' row-structure is stable and matches m
          @ maintaining (\forall int ii; 0 <= ii && ii < n; a[ii] != null && b[ii] != null
          @                                       && a[ii].length == m && b[ii].length == m);
          @ maintaining (\forall int ii; 0 <= ii < i;
          @                 (\forall int jj; 0 <= jj < m;
          @                      c[ii][jj] == a[ii][jj] + b[ii][jj]));
          @ decreases n - i;
          @*/
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            /*@
              @ // Inner loop invariant: columns 0..j-1 of row i have been processed
              @ maintaining 0 <= j && j <= m;
              @ // i must be a valid row index while inside inner loop
              @ maintaining 0 <= i && i < n;
              @ // c has length n and row i is allocated with length m
              @ maintaining c.length == n;
              @ maintaining c[i] != null && c[i].length == m;
              @ // corresponding rows of inputs exist and have length m
              @ maintaining a[i] != null && b[i] != null && a[i].length == m && b[i].length == m;
              @ // processed prefix of row i is correct
              @ maintaining (\forall int jj; 0 <= jj < j; c[i][jj] == a[i][jj] + b[i][jj]);
              @ decreases m - j;
              @*/
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                c[i][j] = a[i][j] + b[i][j];
            }
        }

        return c;
    }
}
```

Why this helps: the added explicit invariants c.length == n and c[i].length == m together with a[i].length == m and b[i].length == m provide the prover the concrete equalities needed to conclude that when the loop guard gives j < m, it implies j < c[i].length, j < a[i].length and j < b[i].length, so the array reads/writes are safe. This resolves the UndefinedTooLargeIndex / PossiblyTooLargeIndex proof obligations.

```
      @ 
```
```
      @ // The method may write the freshly allocated result array and its elements.
      @ assigns \result, \result[*];
      @ 
      @ // Result is a freshly allocated matrix of same dimensions with entrywise sums.
      @ ensures \result != null;
      @ ensures \fresh(\result);
      @ ensures \result.length == a.length;

      @            0 <= ii < a.length && 0 <= jj < a[ii].length
      @            ==> \result[ii][jj] == a[ii][jj] + b[ii][jj]);
      @ 
      @ // inputs are not modified
      @ ensures (\forall int ii, jj;
      @            0 <= ii < a.length && 0 <= jj < a[ii].length
      @            ==> a[ii][jj] == \old(a[ii][jj]) && b[ii][jj] == \old(b[ii][jj]));
      @*/
    public static int[][] matrixSum(int[][] a, int[][] b) {
        int n = a.length;
        int m = a[0].length;

        int[][] c = new int[n][m];

        //@ assert c.length == n;
        //@ assert (\forall int ii; 0 <= ii && ii < n; c[ii] != null);
        //@ assert (\forall int ii; 0 <= ii && ii < n; c[ii].length == m);

        /*@
          @ // Outer loop invariant: rows 0..i-1 have been fully processed
          @ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n;
          @ // c has the same number of rows as n
          @ maintaining c.length == n;
          @ // every row of c is allocated and has length m
          @ maintaining (\forall int ii; 0 <= ii && ii < n; c[ii] != null && c[ii].length == m);
          @ // inputs' row-structure is stable and matches m
          @ maintaining (\forall int ii; 0 <= ii && ii < n; a[ii] != null && b[ii] != null
          @                                       && a[ii].length == m && b[ii].length == m);
          @ maintaining (\forall int ii; 0 <= ii < i;
          @                 (\forall int jj; 0 <= jj < m;
          @                      c[ii][jj] == a[ii][jj] + b[ii][jj]));
          @ decreases n - i;
          @*/
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            /*@
              @ // Inner loop invariant: columns 0..j-1 of row i have been processed
              @ maintaining 0 <= j && j <= m;
              @ // i must be a valid row index while inside inner loop
              @ maintaining 0 <= i && i < n;
              @ // c has length n and row i is allocated with length m
              @ maintaining c.length == n;
              @ maintaining c[i] != null && c[i].length == m;

              @ maintaining a[i] != null && b[i] != null && a[i].length == m && b[i].length == m;
              @ // processed prefix of row i is correct
              @ maintaining (\forall int jj; 0 <= jj < j; c[i][jj] == a[i][jj] + b[i][jj]);
              @ decreases m - j;
              @*/
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                c[i][j] = a[i][j] + b[i][j];
            }
        }

        return c;
```

```
public class Add {
    public static int add(int x, int y) {
        int sum = x;
        if (y > 0) {
            int n = y;
            while (n > 0) {
                sum = sum + 1;
                n = n - 1;
            }
        } else {
            int n = -y;
            while (n > 0) {
                sum = sum - 1;
                n = n - 1;
            }
        }
        return sum;
    }
}
```

```
      @ requires (\forall int r; 0 <= r < mat.length; mat[r] != null);
      @ requires mat.length == 0 || (\forall int r; 0 <= r < mat.length; mat[r].length == mat[0].length);
      @ assigns \nothing;
      @ ensures \result == (\forall int i; 1 <= i < mat.length; \forall int j; 1 <= j < mat[i].length; mat[i][j] == mat[i-1][j-1]);
      @*/
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        /*@ 
```
```
          @ maintaining 1 <= i && i <= n;
```
```
          @ maintaining (\forall int ii; 1 <= ii && ii < i; \forall int jj; 1 <= jj && jj < m; mat[ii][jj] == mat[ii-1][jj-1]);
          @ loop_writes \nothing;
```

Explanation: The verifier complained about a possibly negative index at mat[i-1][j-1]. i is already guaranteed >= 1 by the outer loop invariant. For j we need to ensure j >= 1 whenever the inner loop body executes. The inner-loop invariant was strengthened to the disjunction (m <= 1) || (1 <= j && j < m) so that:
- it holds at loop entry even when m <= 1 (the inner loop then cannot run), and
- when the loop condition j < m holds (i.e. the body may execute), the disjunction forces 1 <= j, hence j-1 is non-negative and the access mat[i-1][j-1] is safe.

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

    }
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
      @ // if arr[i] is whitespace -> same character;

      @ // else -> Character.toLowerCase(arr[i]).
      @ ensures (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < arr.length;

      @               ? \result[i] == Character.toTitleCase(arr[i])
      @               : \result[i] == Character.toLowerCase(arr[i]) )));
      @ 
```
```
      @ behaviors disjoint;
      @ behaviors complete;
      @*/
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        /*@ 
          @ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n;
          @ // for all processed positions j < i, ret[j] has the specified value
          @ maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i;
          @                 (Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) && ret[j] == arr[j])

          @                    ? ret[j] == Character.toTitleCase(arr[j])
          @                    : ret[j] == Character.toLowerCase(arr[j]) )));
          @ // the local flag wordStart reflects whether position i is the start of a word
          @ maintaining wordStart == (i == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[i-1]));
          @ loop_writes ret[*], i, wordStart;
          @ decreases n - i;
          @*/
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
```

```
    public static boolean isLeapYear(int year) {

            if (year % 100 == 0) {
                if (year % 400 == 0)
```

```
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```

```
public class ScalarProductSaturated {
    public static int[] scalarProductSaturated(int[] vec, int a) {
        if (vec == null) return null;
        int ret[] = new int[vec.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < vec.length; i++) {
            long prod = (long) vec[i] * (long) a;
            if (prod > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            } else if (prod < Integer.MIN_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
            } else {
                ret[i] = (int) prod;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }
}

```
